name: MIG / MAG Welders
intro: Gas-shielded MIG/MAG welding machines with dual-drive wire feeders for continuous production welding. The MIG/MMA series also switches to stick welding, making one machine cover two processes on the same workshop floor. Duty cycles up to 100% at rated current support structural steel plants and fabrication lines, and each unit ships complete with torch, cables, ground clamp and CO2 regulator.
seoTitle: MIG/MAG Welding Machines with Dual-Drive Feeder | GOWELLDE
seoDescription: Factory-direct MIG/MAG welders 250A-630A with dual-drive wire feeders and MMA function. Up to 100% duty cycle, complete accessory package, OEM/ODM from China.
